captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a high-end cinema zoom lens with a cylindrical alloy barrel. It features a series of rotatable geared rings: a grey focus ring towards the front, a blue zoom ring in the middle, and a black iris/aperture ring towards the rear. The front of the lens houses a recessed green-tinted optical element, while the rear is finished with a standard PL mount base plate.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cinema zoom lens. The lens should feature an alloy main barrel, a rotatable grey focus ring near the front, a blue zoom ring, a black aperture ring, and a rear PL mount plate. Ensure the rings are modeled with realistic gear teeth and set up with rotational joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a cinema zoom lens assembly by first defining a base cylindrical barrel with concentric cutouts and a rear PL mount plate. Geared rings (focus, zoom, and iris) are modeled by creating a base cylinder, applying polar arrays of small rectangular cutters to form the external gear teeth, and then coloring them grey, blue, and black respectively. A front glass element is modeled as a thin cylinder with a green glass material. Revolute joints are then defined to attach the focus, zoom, and iris rings to the main barrel, allowing them to spin independently.
